description: This file defines test filters for the Starboard Evergreen X64 platform, including filtering specific tests and conditionally removing certain test exclusions based on the presence of a content decryption module.

classes.name: EvergreenX64TestFilters
classes.description: A class that extends shared_test_filters.TestFilters to implement platform-specific test filtering logic for the Evergreen X64 platform.

methods.name: GetTestFilters
methods.description: Retrieves the list of test filters, extending base filters with platform-specific exclusions and conditionally removing certain tests if a content decryption module is present.
